story.iWant: documents and generated content to be deleted automatically after a set time (TTL)
story.soThat: system storage is kept clean, costs are managed, and user data is not retained indefinitely
story.tasks: - [ ] **Backend Service Refactoring:** - [ ] Refactor `DocumentService.delete_document` to separate authorization logic from the core deletion mechanics. - [ ] Create a reusable internal method (e.g., `_perform_document_deletion`) that handles file system removal and DB record deletion. - [ ] Update `delete_document` to verify user ownership first, then call `_perform_document_deletion`. - [ ] Update `delete_old_documents` to: - [ ] Accept a `ttl_hours` parameter (or read from config). - [ ] Query for expired documents. - [ ] Iterate and call `_perform_document_deletion` for each. - [ ] Log success/failure counts (AC #1, #4). - [ ] **Configuration:** - [ ] Add `DOCUMENT_TTL_HOURS` to `app/core/config.py` (read from env, default 24). - [ ] **Scheduler Implementation:** - [ ] Update `backend/scheduler.py` to: - [ ] Load the `DOCUMENT_TTL_HOURS` config. - [ ] Run the job at the defined interval. - [ ] Ensure it handles async DB sessions correctly. - [ ] **Testing:** - [ ] **Unit Test:** Verify `delete_old_documents` correctly identifies expired vs. non-expired documents (mocking time). - [ ] **Unit Test:** Verify `_perform_document_deletion` handles missing files gracefully (Scenario 4). - [ ] **Integration Test:** Simulate a scheduler run and verify the database and file system are cleaned up.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. **Given** a document older than `DOCUMENT_TTL_HOURS`, **When** the job runs, **Then** it is deleted from DB and Disk. 2. **Given** a document newer than `DOCUMENT_TTL_HOURS`, **When** the job runs, **Then** it is NOT deleted. 3. **Given** an expired document with missing physical file, **When** the job runs, **Then** the DB record is still deleted (no crash). 4. **Given** multiple expired documents, **When** the job runs, **Then** all are deleted and the count is logged.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR2.4: The system SHALL delete uploaded documents... after a defined TTL.

file.reason: Contains existing `delete_document` (user-facing) and `delete_old_documents` (admin-facing, currently broken/duplicated). Needs refactoring for DRY.
Entry point for the scheduled task. Needs to use the refactored service and config.

constraints.constraint: Must strictly reuse deletion logic (DRY principle) to avoid inconsistent states.
Must handle "file not found" errors gracefully during deletion to ensure DB is cleaned up.
Logging must be sufficient to audit the number of deleted files.

tests.ideas: - Mock `datetime.utcnow` to simulate documents aging past the TTL. - Create a temporary file, create a DB record, run the deletion, assert both are gone. - Create a DB record *without* a file, run deletion, assert DB record is gone and no exception raised.
